title: Rational Numbers as Decimals
summary: Why every fraction's decimal either stops or repeats, and how to turn a recurring decimal back into a fraction.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): The World of Numbers

objectives: I can predict whether a fraction has a terminating or recurring decimal.
I can convert a recurring decimal to a fraction.
I can explain why rational decimals must terminate or repeat.
misconceptions: A long decimal must be irrational.
